name: repopulse
description: A personal NestJS API for one GitHub private activity SVG card.

scripts.format: prettier --write src README.md ARCHITECTURE.md package.json tsconfig.json eslint.config.mjs .github vercel.json
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src README.md ARCHITECTURE.md package.json tsconfig.json eslint.config.mjs .github vercel.json
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run format:check
